messages:
zoe_marketing: quick sync  final copy for product launch post is at https://docs.example.com/launch-v5. Need fast passes on benchmark wording, CTA routing, and JP/DE short copies. aiming to lock by tomorrow noon. :spiral_calendar:

eli_growth: Ill take CTAs + A/B plan. Recommend splitting by intent + region (webinar-first vs quickstart-first). Will add GA event names.

hugo_pm: Benchmark source: internal bench-v3 on identical hardware (A100). Current line reads 'up to 30% lower p99 latency'  prefer "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)". Also we should include a one-line methodology.

sam_legal: Please avoid superlatives. Draft legal-safe sentence: "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware; methodology: 3,000 requests, mixed seq lengths, p99 measured across 5 runs." Remove words like "guarantee" or "industry-leading."

mina_ops: For routing playbook include mapping: ```routes = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}``` Webinar ops: EU slots Tue/Thu 10am CET, capacity 40 -> auto-waitlist at 40. Also add UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_v5&utm_variant=A|B`.

eli_growth: CTA short copies (<=45 chars):
- Variant A (webinar): "Join our launch webinar" -> tags: `lead:webinar`, `route:region-based`
- Variant B (quickstart): "Read the quickstart & deploy" -> tags: `lead:docs`, `route:docs-flow`
JP short: Variant A = ""
DE short: Variant A = "Live-Demo: Jetzt anmelden". I'll paste JP final into the doc.

zoe_marketing: pasted Sams legal sentence and the methodology block into the draft. Reworded superlatives to "industry-competitive." Link updated: https://docs.example.com/launch-v5#final.

sam_legal: LGTM after tiny tweak: change semicolon to a period between the benchmark sentence and methodology, and replace "representative" (if present) with nothing.

hugo_pm: made that punctuation tweak in the doc. Also adjusted benchmark phrase to "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)."

eli_growth: A/B plan approved. I'll create the GA tags and the experiment in Growth. Suggest 2-week test, then evaluate conversion and demo signups.

mina_ops: ops ready for scheduling once copy locked. Please confirm final CTAs and routing mapping so we can configure registration flow.

zoe_marketing: all set  Ill mark copy locked tomorrow at noon if no objections. Thanks everyone :rocket:
